claims.description: List of source-supported atomic findings extracted from target sentences, or [] if the target sentences report no eligible finding.

subject.description: First source-worded endpoint copied as printed, keeping abbreviations unexpanded (e.g., 'LP' or 'P', never rewriting 'LP' into 'low phosphorus (LP)'). Keep genuine joint treatments and compound traits/ratios intact; split independently reported outcomes.

subject_type.description: Scientific role of the subject in this sentence (use 'assay variable' for named assay/protocol metrics, 'trait or measurement' for narrative phenotypic traits, and 'other' when unclear).

relation.description: Short source-faithful predicate linking subject to object while preserving reported direction, predicate strength ('affects' must stay 'affects', never 'improves'), negation, uncertainty, and comparison phrasing.

object.description: Second source-worded endpoint copied as printed, keeping abbreviations unexpanded and defining organs, states, efficiencies, or ratios intact. Never bundle independently reported outcomes into one object.

object_type.description: Scientific role of the object in this sentence (a substance, its supply/exposure, and a measured post-exposure trait have distinct types).

assertion_status.description: 'affirmed': observed effect, difference, or explicit stability (e.g. 'remained constant'); 'negated': explicit absence or lack of reaction ('was not found', 'did not react'); 'non_significant': explicit statistical non-significance ('did not significantly change'); 'uncertain': hedged or speculative wording ('may', 'might', 'could', 'expected', 'suggests').

qualifiers.description: Contextual details supporting this specific finding without erasing defining words from the endpoints. Use null for unstated keys.

population.description: Cultivars, genotypes, or study groups associated with this finding.

condition.description: Experimental setting, treatment regime, growth medium, timepoint, or scope.

comparator.description: Baseline treatment, control, or comparison group paired with this finding.

metric.description: Quantitative value, count, percentage, or statistical magnitude belonging specifically to this finding.

support_sentence_ids.description: Optional sorted ascending integer IDs of qualifier-supporting sentences not already cited in subject_anchor, relation_anchor, or object_anchor. Omit or use [] when the three anchors cover all cited sentences.

sentence_id.description: Sentence ID containing the verbatim subject quote.

quote.description: Verbatim span from sentence_id naming the subject (for shared-word coordinations, quote the full coordinated phrase).

relation_anchor.description: Verbatim source provenance for the predicate in a target sentence.

sentence_id.description: MUST be one of the sentences labeled 'target' (never a 'neighbor'-only sentence).

quote.description: Shortest contiguous verbatim span from target sentence_id establishing the predicate, its polarity, uncertainty, and non-significance (may enclose intervening qualifiers for split predicates).

sentence_id.description: Sentence ID containing the verbatim object quote.

quote.description: Verbatim span from sentence_id naming the object (for shared-word coordinations, quote the full coordinated phrase).
